en.headline: Hang Seng Index falls 1.3 per cent to close at 23,867
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks joined a regional retreat on Tuesday after Beijing left key lending rates unchanged and stronger mainland GDP data reduced expectations for further stimulus.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed down 319 points, or 1.3 per cent, at 23,867 on Tuesday. The Hang Seng Tech Index lost 1.5 per cent to 4,045, and the China Enterprises Index fell 1.2 per cent to 8,030. Turnover was HK$190.45 billion.

Market reports linked the decline to the People’s Bank of China keeping its one-year and five-year loan prime rates unchanged, together with stronger-than-expected mainland growth figures that tempered hopes for additional easing. Lenovo was among the weakest blue-chip performers, falling nearly 10 per cent.

Mainland blue-chip indices also softened. The CSI 300 ended lower while the Shanghai Composite edged slightly higher. Gold-related shares and parts of the financial sector were under pressure as bullion prices continued to ease.

zh.headline: 恆生指數跌百分之一點三 收報二萬三千八百六十七點
zh.dek: 周二港股隨區域市場回落，內地維持貸款利率不變及較強經濟數據令市場對進一步刺激預期降溫。
body: 恆生指數周二下跌三百一十九點，或百分之一點三，收報二萬三千八百六十七點。恆生科技指數跌百分之一點五，報四千零四十五點；國企指數跌百分之一點二，報八千零三十點。成交額一千九百零四億五千萬港元。
市場報告指，回落與人民銀行維持一年及五年期貸款市場報價利率不變，以及內地經濟數據較預期強勁、令進一步寬鬆預期降溫有關。聯想集團是表現最差的藍籌股之一，跌近一成。
內地藍籌指數亦走弱。滬深三百收低，上證指數則輕微上升。黃金相關股份及部分金融股受金價持續回軟壓力。
